raw.details:
TEJAS INDIA HACKATHON 2026:

Overview:

  • TEJAS INDIA HACKATHON 2026 is a national-level 8-hour hackathon organized in association with the District Industries Centre, Sheikhpura, bringing together students, innovators, developers, and problem-solvers from across India.
  • Hackathon Date: 18 September 2026.
  • Idea Submission Deadline: 13 September 2026.
  • Final Shortlisting: Top 15 Teams.
  • Hackathon Duration: 8 Hours.

Domains:

  • Sustainable Development: Solutions promoting clean energy, waste management, water conservation, and climate action.
  • FinTech: Innovative financial solutions for inclusion, digital payments, lending, and wealth management.
  • E-Commerce: Platforms and tools transforming online shopping, logistics, customer experience, and digital marketplaces.
  • Agriculture: Smart farming, agri-tech, supply chain optimization, and sustainable livelihood solutions for farmers.
  • Drone Tech: Drone-based solutions for mapping, monitoring, delivery, and agricultural applications.
  • Modern Healthcare: Digital health, telemedicine, AI diagnostics, and affordable healthcare solutions.
  • Smart Education: EdTech solutions improving access to quality education, digital learning, and skill development.
  • Circular Economy: Innovations in recycling, upcycling, resource efficiency, and sustainable business models.
  • Open Innovation: Breakthrough ideas in AI, IoT, robotics, blockchain, and other emerging technologies.
  • Bihar Tourism: Creative solutions to promote tourism, heritage, culture, and local experiences in Bihar.

Selection Process:

  • Participants will submit their innovative idea under any one of the 10 domains.
  • Ideas will be evaluated based on Innovation & Originality, Problem Relevance, Feasibility & Practical Implementation, Potential Impact, and Scalability & Future Potential.
  • The Top 15 Teams will be shortlisted based on the submitted ideas.
  • Shortlisted teams will participate in the 8-hour final hackathon on 18 September 2026.
  • Teams will develop, implement, and present their proposed solutions during the final hackathon.

Benefits:

  • Free refreshments and food during the hackathon.
  • Participation certificate.
  • Mentorship and expert guidance.
  • Networking opportunities.
  • Opportunity to showcase innovative solutions.
  • Chance to compete for exciting prizes.

Prizes & Recognition:
Top 3 Winning Teams:

  • Top prizes.
  • Medals.
  • Cash prizes.
  • Certificates and recognition.

Other Selected Teams:

  • Participation certificates.
  • Recognition for their participation.
  • Networking and learning opportunities.

Eligibility:

  • Students from Engineering, Technology, Computer Science, Management, and other disciplines can participate.
  • Developers, designers, entrepreneurs, researchers, and innovative problem-solvers are welcome to participate.
  • Participants should be passionate about technology, innovation, entrepreneurship, and problem-solving.

Event Details:

  • Final Hackathon: 18 September 2026.
  • Duration: 8 Hours.
  • Final Teams: Top 15.
  • Organized in association with the District Industries Centre, Sheikhpura, Government of Bihar.

Submission Deadline:

  • The content mentions both 13 September 2026 and 10 September 2026 as the idea submission deadline. Please verify the correct deadline with the organizing team.
